doc.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018

title: How Watkins approaches composing a chart
summary: He starts with instrumentation and existing ideas, and records fresh tune ideas each morning.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Oh. A familiar name, yeah. So if I commissioned you to write a chart, let’s say for a ten piece band, anything you wanted. How would you approach that? How do you get started?

Well I the starting point has to be — well anything I want then I would think well who am I? What do I really want? And the first thing would be the instrumentation. So if I could do whatever I wanted, it doesn’t have to be a college big band. If it’s a ten piece band it could be anything, right? It could be two drummers. So I would think a lot about the instrumentation. I would also think about some of the musical compositional ideas that I have that are kind of on deck to be set into something more complete. Because I have a lot of ideas, I think a lot of musicians do. Snippets. Compositions. Parts of compositions. Movements of — so I would look at what I already have. I would think about something, you know, maybe something that’s brand new but instrumentation I think is a good start.
And where does the initial melodic idea — do you stumble across those things? Do you vocalize them? Do you sit at the piano?

All of the above. I get — in the morning I typically get these flashes of tunes, they feel fresh. If they feel fresh they’re fresh. You know, maybe twelve hours later you say ah it’s been done before. But if it comes across and feels fresh I’ll record those little ideas and I’ll think about them and think about them and try to let them grow you know. I have other songs, I have sections of songs where it’s like introducing, it’s like playing matchmaker. Introducing — oh, have you met, have you met? He’s in the same key as you.
He’s 24 bars, I know you’re 16 bars but —
You guys would be very compatible together.
